$note: AirKenya Express 2026 scheduled route network, full network beyond the Amboseli-Mara-Nanyuki legs already captured in flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json (that file covers Airvan/Safarilink only, not AirKenya, so nothing here duplicates it).
carrier: AirKenya Express (with Regional Air Services Tanzania, Aerolink Uganda as connecting sister airlines)

source.extractionMethod: Both PDFs are image-only (scanned/flattened to JPEG per page, no embedded text layer) - extracted via direct visual read of each page image, not a flattened text dump. Page-by-page, no adjacent-route misattribution risk since each route has its own clearly labeled table.
source.addressee: Gabrielle (Sunworld Safaris) from Anne Hiri, Regional Sales Manager

seasons.note: Fares in the rate table are NOT season-differentiated by figure - only one fare per route is published. The high/low season split governs scheduling/routing (e.g. some routes go non-operational or reroute via Wilson in low season) and ticketing time limits (21 days high season / 14 days low+mid season), not the fare amount itself.

fareStructure: Gross Fare and Net Fare both shown per route; Taxes shown separately and must be added to Net Fare. All figures below are as published (Gross / Net / Taxes), USD, per adult unless noted.

childPolicy.infantsUnder2: Free, provided they do not occupy a seat.
childPolicy.note: No explicit Young Adult (12-17) bracket stated in this document - falls under the general adult fare by default (age 12+ = adult fare here, distinct from the Soroi portfolio's separate 12-17 Young Adult 75%-of-adult convention).

minimumPax.international: 4 passengers per sector (e.g. Wilson-Kilimanjaro-Wilson; Masai Mara-Entebbe-Mara via Kisumu)

wilsonToAmboseli.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Inbound Amboseli-Wilson connects onward to Nanyuki, Lewa Downs, Samburu, Meru, Loisaba at 09:45; Maasai Mara at 10:30; Kilimanjaro at 13:30.

wilsonToKilimanjaro.notes: Daily; min 4 pax (international sector). Non-operational 1 Apr - 20 May and 1 Nov - 15 Dec. Connects to Arusha, Manyara, Kogatende, Lobo, Serengeti via Regional Air Services at 15:30.

wilsonToLewaSamburu.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Covers Lewa/Kalama/Buffalo Springs airstrips, timings vary by routing. Inbound to Wilson connects Kilimanjaro at 13:30, Masai Mara at 14:00.

lewaSamburuToMasaiMara.notes: May route via Wilson to connect the 14:00 Masai Mara service in low season.

wilsonToLoisaba.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Multiple airstrips, timing varies. Inbound to Wilson connects Kilimanjaro 13:30, Masai Mara 14:00.

loisabaToMasaiMara.notes: May route via Wilson in low season to connect the 14:00 Masai Mara service.

wilsonToMasaiMara.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Multiple airstrips in the Mara, timings vary by routing.

wilsonToMasaiMaraSpecial.notes: Special offer applies specifically to flights 851/852 (Wilson-Mara 07:30/08:00, Mara-Wilson 08:05/09:35 approx) and 951/952 (Wilson-Mara 14:00, Mara-Wilson approx). Not the general Wilson-Mara fare - a named-flight promotional fare.

maraToMigori.notes: Daily, min 2 pax, except non-operational 1 Apr-20 May and min 4 pax required 1 Nov-15 Dec.
maraToMigori.unitNote: Table header says 'vv' (vice versa) - applies both directions at this fare.

maraToTarime.notes: Vice versa. Connects Masai Mara-Tarime-Mara services to Serengeti via Regional Air Services, Auric Air, or Coastal Aviation - contact AirKenya for the connecting-carrier leg.

wilsonToMeru.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Multiple airstrips; inbound to Wilson connects Kilimanjaro 13:30, Masai Mara 14:00.

meruToMasaiMara.notes: May route via Wilson in low season to connect 14:00 Mara service.

meruToSamburu.notes: One-direction service only (Meru->Samburu/Kalama), per source document.

wilsonToNanyukiKamok.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Covers Nanyuki or Kamok airstrips. Inbound to Wilson connects Kilimanjaro 13:30, Masai Mara 14:00.

nanyukiToMasaiMara.notes: May route via Wilson in low season to connect 14:00 Mara service. NOTE: this AirKenya figure ($446 gross) is a separate/different carrier and fare structure from the Safarilink Nanyuki-Masai Mara fare already on file in flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json ($441 published / $374.80 nett + $15 tax) - do not conflate the two; they are alternative carriers for the same route.

nanyukiMeruNanyuki.notes: Daily; min 2 pax. Multiple airstrips, timing may vary.

maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarime.notes: Fares apply between AirKenya and either Regional Air Services, Auric Air, or Coastal Aviation (connecting carrier's own T&Cs apply on the Tanzania sector), either direction. Daily, min 2 pax except non-operational 1 Apr-20 May and min 4 pax 1 Nov-15 Dec.

circuitDiscounts.note: Applies to gross fares only, throughout the AirKenya/subsidiary network. All sectors must be on one booking reference/voucher (else each sector charged independently). One ticket for all sectors. Travel cannot repeat the same destination; total circuit must not exceed 14 days. Circuit and Group discounts are NOT combinable.
circuitDiscounts.taxNote: Taxes are payable per sector regardless of circuit discount, and are additive (e.g. Wilson-Mara return $34 + Wilson-JRO return $138 = $172 total taxes for that combined routing).

groupDiscounts.tenPlusPax: 20% off gross fare, scheduled flights only
groupDiscounts.sixteenPlusPax: 25% off gross fare, scheduled flights only
groupDiscounts.note: Applies year-round. Group and circuit discounts not combinable. Must be booked through AirKenya offices.

baggage.prePurchaseBundle: 1-10kg extra for a flat $50 (book 48hrs+ before departure, max 10kg extra/pax)
baggage.freightSeat: 75kg/165lbs allowance, charged at child's fare + taxes

cancellationAmendment.noShow: Non-transferable, non-refundable, 6-month validity, revalidation fee $100/ticket subject to availability.
cancellationAmendment.refundAdminFee: $20/ticket plus 5% PSP commission on card payments and bank charges on transfers; refunds paid within 45 days.

checkIn.mainAirports: 60 minutes before departure at Wilson, Kilimanjaro, Kisumu, Entebbe (and Arusha per schedule doc); gate closes 30 min before departure.

scheduleHighlights.note: Full flight-number-level schedule (P2-prefixed) is in the source schedule PDF; only representative daily-first-flight times captured here since exact rotations vary by aircraft routing day to day per the source's own disclaimer ('call Airkenya operations on departure date to confirm').

notesGeneral: Fares quoted in USD; may be converted to KES at prevailing IATA rate at time of payment. AirKenya reserves right to adjust fares at any time.
Contract must be signed and a copy returned to Airkenya Express.
Private/helicopter charters available on request via charters@airkenya.com if scheduled service doesn't meet routing/timing needs.
